name: Vessa
description: A village of crooked slate roofs and crooked mages, huddled against a rainy coast.

shore.name: The Wrack Line
shore.description: A cold beach of black pebbles strewn with splintered pine and a length of grey sail. Overhead the clouds are breaking. Inland, a path of slate steps climbs between crooked houses.

lane.name: The Slate Lane
lane.description: A narrow lane of wet slate, every doorway hung with charms against the sea, and every other one with something that has plainly gone wrong.

square.name: The Crooked Square
square.description: A small square around a leaning well. Every house faces a different way. The tallest, to the west, has a door that has been repainted too many times, and a plaque: ELDER. Beyond the north houses the road lifts toward a mountain wrapped in cloud.

north.failure_message: The road north is Mount Vigil's, and the elder has not yet said you may take it.

elder_hall.name: The Elder's Hall
elder_hall.description: A warm, cluttered room that smells of tea and old books. Two children sit on a rug in front of the stove, being not quite quiet.
